name: Codespaces host storage tuning
description: Tunes the network-backed storage stack under the docker root of the Codespaces VM host (readahead, FUSE queue depth, noatime, dirty-page limits) and optionally prefetches the working set into the host's local cache. Runs on the host through the docker socket at every container start. Disabled unless the ENABLE_STORAGE_TUNING / ENABLE_STORAGE_PREWARM secrets are set.

dockerSocket.description: Path inside the container where the host's docker socket is mounted (docker-outside-of-docker mounts it at /var/run/docker-host.sock).

helperImage.description: Image for the throw-away privileged helper container; it only needs `nsenter`. Empty means: reuse this dev container's own image (no pull).

warmReaders.description: Parallel O_DIRECT readers used by the prewarm (apply-tunables.py --readers).

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the host-side run after this many seconds (0 disables). Interrupting it is harmless; the prewarm simply stops early.
